correctness.rationale: The determinant theorem is correctly applied with the cube Laplacian eigenvalues \(2|S|\) and normalized Walsh characters. Expansion gives the exact A/B integrals and sign. The integrands prove strict inequalities. Standard interior, boundary and Gaussian Laplace calculations yield all constants (interior curvature \(-1/(4\rho(1-\rho))\), central exponent \(-u^2/2-2su\)). Exact ground-Laplacian, independent determinant counting, and symbolic rational integrals passed 239 checker comparisons for \(d\le5\) and ordering cases through 14; finite checks are corroboration, not infinite proof.
